text:
I need to determine which New York borough contains Hell's Kitchen.

Hell's Kitchen is a well-known neighborhood in New York City. It is located on the west side of Midtown Manhattan, roughly between 34th Street and 59th Street, west of Eighth Avenue to the Hudson River.

All four agents agree that the answer is Manhattan, with very high confidence scores (0.98-1.00). This consensus aligns with my knowledge that Hell's Kitchen is indeed a Manhattan neighborhood. There is no ambiguity here - Hell's Kitchen has always been part of Manhattan and is one of its most recognizable neighborhoods.

Answer: Manhattan
Confidence: 1.00
